stories.title: Automate month-end journal entry imports
stories.summary: Replace the manual CSV upload of intercompany journal entries with a scheduled integration from the legacy GL, cutting month-end close by an estimated two days.

stories.title: Chart of accounts mapping workbench
stories.summary: Give finance a UI to map legacy account codes to the new consolidated chart of accounts, with validation rules and an audit log of mapping changes.

stories.title: Unified customer master record
stories.summary: Consolidate duplicate customer records across the DMS, CRM, and billing systems into a single golden record with survivorship rules.

stories.title: Machine sales order status portal
stories.summary: Customer-facing view of machine order status from factory order through delivery, pulling build and shipping milestones from the DMS.

stories.title: Lead scoring and routing rules
stories.summary: Score inbound web and event leads on fit and intent, then auto-route to the right territory rep with an SLA timer and escalation.

stories.title: Quote approval workflow with discount guardrails
stories.summary: Multi-level quote approvals driven by discount depth and deal size, replacing email approvals; includes margin visibility for approvers.

stories.title: Offline work order completion for field techs
stories.summary: Let field technicians complete work orders, capture photos, and record parts used without connectivity, syncing when back in coverage.

stories.title: Technician schedule board with drag-and-drop dispatch
stories.summary: Dispatcher view showing tech availability, skills, and travel time; drag jobs between techs and days with conflict warnings.

stories.title: Parts demand forecasting pilot
stories.summary: Forecast fast-moving parts demand per branch using 24 months of sales history and seasonality; measure against current min/max stocking.

stories.title: Emergency parts order expedite tracking
stories.summary: Track expedited parts orders end-to-end with carrier milestones and proactive customer notifications on delays.

stories.title: Rental unit utilization dashboard
stories.summary: Hours, idle days, and revenue per rental asset from telematics feeds, rolled up by branch and product family.

stories.title: Automated off-rent inspection checklist
stories.summary: Digital inspection at off-rent with photo capture and automatic damage billing draft, replacing the paper tri-form.

stories.title: Enterprise data lakehouse landing zone
stories.summary: Stand up the governed landing zone (storage, catalog, access model) that ERP, CRM, and telematics data will flow into — the foundation for all AI use cases.

stories.title: Service call summarization assistant pilot
stories.summary: LLM-assisted summarization of service call notes into structured cause/correction codes, piloted with one branch's service writers.

stories.title: Generator sizing calculator integration
stories.summary: Embed the OEM generator sizing tool into the quoting flow so spec data flows straight into the quote instead of being rekeyed.

stories.title: Standby power maintenance agreement renewals
stories.summary: Automate renewal quotes for expiring standby generator maintenance agreements with indexed pricing and one-click acceptance.

comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.text: Everything in the AI epic is blocked until this lands. I'd argue this is top 3 regardless of its own revenue story.

comments.author: Marcus Lee
comments.text: Agree on sequencing, but it's an XL — does it crowd out everything else for two sprints?

comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.text: Parts margin impact here is the strongest business case we have on paper. Feasibility hinges on branch data quality.
